task_title: FY revenue and share table (spreadsheet output)

criteria.text: States that total FY revenue across all sectors is Rs 8,018 crore.
States that IT Services is the largest sector by FY revenue at Rs 1,855 crore.
Reports the IT Services share of FY revenue as approximately 23.1%.
Reports Banking FY revenue as Rs 1,605 crore (spot check).
Reports Automobile FY revenue as Rs 780 crore (spot check).
Presents the result as a table sorted by FY revenue.
Reports a total FY revenue other than Rs 8,018 crore.
Reports sector shares that do not sum to approximately 100%.
